messages:
Carmen Vega: heads-up, we just saw a sharp p95+p99 spike on hosted API in us-west-2 starting ~09:02 UTC, looks correlated with queue depth increase on runtime pool A
Ben K: ok what's the delta? numbers?
Carmen Vega: p95 jumped from 120ms -> 620ms, p99 -> 1.8s, throughput slightly down, error rate stable
Alice M: any noisy tenant candidates? logs show a bunch of long-sequence requests hitting the same shard
Carmen Vega: we flagged tenant-42 (high batch sizes, seq len ~2048) and a bunch of mixed-precision fallbacks
Kyle S: also saw many kernel fallbacks to aux kernels around that time, kernel-selector logs:
```
[2026-03-18T09:01:58Z] kernel-selector: prefer=fp16_gemm selected=aux_slow (latency_penalty=1.7) reason=kv-cache-invalid
[2026-03-18T09:02:03Z] batch-coalescer: window=15ms batches=322 -> coalesce_delay=20ms
```
Ben K: kv-cache-invalid? could be KV cache eviction churn due to tenant prefetch patterns
perf-bot: perf-alert: host/runtime-A: p99 latency 1.82s, queue_depth 48, batch_size_mean 11.7
Carmen Vega: we profiled runtime-A GPU: high memcpy traffic and frequent kernel swaps; likely contention on shared mempool
Alice M: current mitigation: reduce coalescing window to 5ms on pool A and temporarily throttle tenant-42 to rate=0.2 x baseline
Kyle S: started change now, rolling config via runtime-config: `coalesce_ms=5` -> applied to pool A
Ben K: also scaled pool A from 8 -> 12 instances to help drain backlog
Carmen Vega: logs 09:06 show immediate queue drop, p95 trending down to ~180ms
perf-bot: perf-update: 09:10 p95=190ms p99=420ms queue_depth=12 batch_size_mean=7.2
Alice M: follow-ups: 1) root cause write-up (kernel selector + kv eviction interplay) 2) add metric for fallback_count by tenant 3) add rate-limit guard for long-seq tenants
Kyle S: quick theory: tenant-42's prefetcher triggered heavy KV churn, invalidated local caches, causing kernel-selector to choose aux kernels with worse throughput; combined with long coalesce windows produced big batches that stressed memcpy
Ben K: agree. Need microtrace to confirm: capture kernel-selector decisions + kv-cache events around faults. I'll add tracepoints
Carmen Vega: owners: Ben -> add tracepoints + gather mmap/memcpy profiles; Alice -> write incident summary and rollout plan for better per-tenant guards; Kyle -> PR for adaptive coalesce_ms (auto-shrink when queue_depth > 20)
Alice M: scheduling postmortem doc, will include timeline, logs and screenshots. ETA EOD
perf-bot: action: created ticket INF-4312 to track follow-ups
oncall-sre: tagging infra team for mempool limits; possible long-term: pin large-seq tenants to dedicated pool
Carmen Vega: thanks team. current status: mitigated, monitoring for recurrence :eyes:
Ben K: :thumbsup: closing loop after postmortem
Alice M: putting a temp alert to fire if fallback_count_by_tenant > 50 in 1m for now
Kyle S: PR for adaptive coalesce started -> link: https://git.redwood/infer/runtime/pulls/284
Carmen Vega: will update if anything else crops up, otherwise we'll run postmortem later
